description: This file defines the ContentUrlTag class, which provides methods for constructing content URLs with appropriate prefixes based on security settings and website configuration. It handles appending content prefixes to URL buffers and determining the correct prefix based on request security and website settings.

classes.name: ContentUrlTag
classes.description: Provides static methods for appending content URL prefixes based on request and website configuration.

methods.name: appendContentPrefix(HttpServletRequest, StringBuilder)
methods.description: Appends the appropriate content URL prefix to a StringBuilder buffer based on request security context.

methods.name: appendContentPrefix(HttpServletRequest, Appendable)
methods.description: Appends the appropriate content URL prefix to an Appendable object, handling null requests and security context.

methods.name: appendContentPrefix(GenericValue, boolean, Appendable)
methods.description: Appends the security-specific content prefix to an Appendable buffer based on website configuration or properties.

methods.name: getContentPrefix(HttpServletRequest)
methods.description: Returns the content URL prefix as a String, based on the current request.
